caption:
More code is generated every month. Someone still has to decide what gets merged.

Reviewing is a skill: spotting the missing edge case, the unnecessary re-render, the security hole that "works fine".

Easy way to practise: open a merged pull request in a popular open source repo, read the diff, write down what you'd ask, then read the real review comments.

For Best Frontend Resources visit https://allahabadi.dev created by Frontend Master

altText:
Practise [[reviewing code]] as seriously as you practise writing it.

That's most of the job now.
